sourceProfile.kernel_origin: supplementary PyTorch benchmark; not rasbt notebook kernel
sourceProfile.label: One step / I=H=16 / reset after recurrent affine / supplied parameters

sourceFacts: The rasbt GRU model previously had an opaque nn.GRU boundary; this separately sourced benchmark function exposes a concrete GRU step.
gi and gh each include their own bias before chunk(3,1); reset multiplies the complete h_n affine slice, including b_hh.
The source inputgate is the standard update z. hy is n + z*(hidden-n); z retains old state.
Weights and biases are Tensor arguments; this function does not register Parameters or prove the caller uses this implementation.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
